subject: Proposed MAP & next steps for Northbound Health procurement
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com>
To: Liam Carter <liam@northboundhealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.inference.com>, procurement@northboundhealth.com
Date: Sun, 05 Sep 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed MAP & next steps for Northbound Health procurement

Hi Liam — great to meet yesterday. Thanks for the clear context on Northbound’s timelines and constraints. Below is a concise recap, a stakeholder sketch I captured during the call, and a proposed Mutual Action Plan (MAP) with suggested owners and dates. Please confirm/modify so we can convert this to a shared spreadsheet and start assigning tasks.

Recap (what we heard)
- Primary goal: accelerate pilot to production for the patient triage assistant by mid-Oct but procurement needs an MOU / commercial signal before resourcing.
- Non-negotiables called out: SOC 2 Type II, data residency in us-east, SSO (SAML/SCIM), and a 95th-pct latency target ~100ms for 512-token gen.
- Expected consumption: ~10M tokens/month in month 1 with step-up commitments if SLA met.

Stakeholder sketch (please confirm):
- Economic buyer: Maya Patel, CFO (approval for spend)
- Technical sponsor: Liam Carter, CTO (integration + perf sign-off)
- Security / evidence owner: Raj Singh, Head of InfoSec (controls & audit)
- Procurement lead: procurement@northboundhealth.com (contract negotiation)
- Exec champion: Dr. Ellen Park (CCS / clinical lead) — flagged during call but not on thread yet

Proposed MAP (high level)
1) Technical deep dive (integration + perf): 2027-09-09 — owner: Liam (Redwood: Rishi) — deliverable: POC runbook and latency baseline.
2) Evidence pack delivery (SOC2, encryption, data flow diagrams): 2027-09-10 — owner: Raj/NBH (Redwood: Vanessa) — deliverable: security summary + sample logs.
3) Commercial term outline & pricing review: 2027-09-13 — owner: Maya/Procurement (Redwood: Sean) — deliverable: draft term sheet + estimate.
4) MOU / Exec alignment: target signature 2027-10-01 — owner: Maya & Dr. Park (Redwood: Sales Lead)
5) Pilot kickoff (technical onboarding): within 7 business days of signed MOU — owner: Liam / Redwood onboarding team.

Open questions for you to confirm:
- Can Maya be the formal budget owner for the deal? If not, who signs?
- Who on your side will own the security evidence collection (Raj OK?)
- Any internal procurement windows or blackout dates in Sep that would push the MOU out?
- Are there any additional compliance checks beyond SOC2 we should pre-prepare for (e.g., HITRUST)?

Attachments (drafts I’m sending):
- NBH_MAP_draft.xlsx (MAP template with milestones and owners)
- redwood-security-summary.pdf (short evidence pack)
- pricing-estimate-Northbound-2027.xlsx (high-level estimate for the pilot and committed tiers)

Next step: can you confirm the econ buyer and security evidence owner by EOD Monday? I’ll update the MAP and circulate a version we can co-edit. I’ve penciled in 9/9 for the technical deep dive — if that doesn’t work for the team we’ll move it.

Thanks — short and actionable here.

— Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com
Attachment: NBH_MAP_draft.xlsx (spreadsheet), redwood-security-summary.pdf (pdf), pricing-estimate-Northbound-2027.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Liam Carter <liam@northboundhealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: procurement@northboundhealth.com
Date: Mon, 06 Sep 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed MAP & next steps for Northbound Health procurement

Vanessa — thanks for the clear write-up and the MAP skeleton. Quick answers below and a couple of tweaks from our side.

- Confirmed economic buyer: Maya Patel (CFO) — she will own budget approval and final sign-off.
- Security evidence owner: Raj Singh (Head of InfoSec) — he will coordinate with you on required artifacts.
- Procurement timeline: Procurement is tied up with a vendor window in the first two weeks of Sept. Can we move the target MOU signature to ~2027-10-15? That gives them time to triage paperwork and aligns better with finance cycles.

I’m attaching our internal procurement checklist that Raj will use to track the evidence pack.

On Mon, Sep 5, 2027 at 2:12 PM Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com> wrote:
> Hi Liam — great to meet yesterday. Thanks for the clear context on Northbound’s timelines and constraints...

—Liam
Liam Carter | CTO, Northbound Health
liam@northboundhealth.com
Attachment: nbh-procurement-checklist.docx (docx)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com>
To: Liam Carter <liam@northboundhealth.com>
Cc: Maya Patel <maya.patel@northboundhealth.com>, Raj Singh <raj.singh@northboundhealth.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.inference.com>, procurement@northboundhealth.com
Date: Tue, 07 Sep 2027 08:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed MAP & next steps for Northbound Health procurement

Liam — perfect, thanks for confirming. I updated the MAP dates below to reflect a target MOU of 2027-10-15 and highlighted owners accordingly. I’ve also noted Raj as the security evidence owner so we’ll coordinate directly on the artifacts.

Updated MAP highlights (changes vs. original)
- Evidence pack delivery: 2027-09-20 — Redwood to deliver SOC2 checklist, encryption summary, and a short sample log export. Owner: Vanessa (Redwood) + Raj (validation).
- Commercial term outline & pricing review: 2027-09-24 — hold for Maya + procurement feedback. Owner: Sean (Redwood).
- MOU target: 2027-10-15 (procurement window slack) — Owner: Maya / Procurement.

Action items I’m taking this week
- Convert the attached MAP draft into a shared spreadsheet and invite the team (ETA: 9/7 EOD) — VANESSA
- Share a short security snapshot and an initial log-sample (ETA: 9/10) — VANESSA

Open items for your team
- Confirm if HITRUST is on your roadmap (yes/no) — Raj/Maya
- Procurement: any preferred contract terms (payment net-30 vs net-45, auto-renew clause) — procurement@northboundhealth.com

I’ll queue a 30-min alignment with Maya and Raj next week — proposing Wed 9/15 at 10:00am PT. If that works, I’ll send a calendar invite and a short agenda (1) evidence expectations (2) pricing guardrails (3) timeline to MOU.

Thanks — Vanessa

> On Mon, Sep 6, 2027 at 9:03 AM Liam Carter <liam@northboundhealth.com> wrote:
> > Vanessa — thanks for the clear write-up and the MAP skeleton...

Attachment: (none in this message)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya.patel@northboundhealth.com>, Raj Singh <raj.singh@northboundhealth.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Sep 2027 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood pre-contract checklist & procurement asks (NBH)

Hi Maya / Raj — I’m looping in to make the commercial and procurement steps as frictionless as possible. Attached is our pre-contract checklist that typically speeds reviews on your side. Quick asks to help us align: 

1) Procurement preference on payment terms (net-30 / net-45) and whether a PO will be required for pilot spend.
2) Any mandatory security questionnaires besides SOC2 (e.g., SIG, CAIQ, HITRUST). If SIG is preferred we can provide a completed copy within 3 business days.
3) Contract redlines: any business terms that must be non-negotiable (data residency, audit rights, indemnity caps).

Next steps we’ll take after your responses:
- Sean will produce a draft term sheet and estimate (ETA 9/24).
- Vanessa will share the evidence pack (ETA 9/10).
- I’ll prepare a short SOW template for the pilot to facilitate procurement sign-off.

Attachment: pre-contract-checklist.pdf

Thanks — happy to jump on a call if it helps accelerate.

— Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachment: pre-contract-checklist.pdf (pdf)
